shortDescription: CVC Capital Partners EURONEXT:CVC said on Wednesday it was naming TPG NASDAQ:TPG executive Todd Sisitsky and CVC insider Peter Rutland as co-chief executive officers of the private equity firm, effective the first quarter of 2028, when current CEO Rob Lucas steps down.
